claim: Data-centre PUE reporting and public disclosure (Ch 6, 8, 17, 18, 20)
detail: ✅ Rechecked November 9, 2026. NRCan’s 2024 guide, page 12, attributes about 22% PUE reporting to its Canadian market assessment. In Figure 6 of Uptime’s 2023 survey, 71% of 716 respondents to a multi-select corporate sustainability question selected PUE. The 2024 figure of 1.56 is average PUE. PUE is an energy-efficiency metric. Covered EU operators at or above 500 kW of installed IT power demand submit facility data annually. Annex II specifies energy and water inputs and Annex III defines PUE and WUE. Article 5 and Annex IV make Member State and Union aggregates public. Article 12 of the directive separately calls for publication of Annex VII information, subject to protections for trade secrets and confidentiality.
